pets: add 'Hatch all ready eggs' — spam-adopting leaves several eggs that each had to be selected and hatched one card at a time, which feels stuck. New button on the My Pets card hatches EVERY ready egg: the value-free hatch auto-signs (a quick wallet bounce), the redirect serialises each, and on return maybeAutoHatch() fires the next until none remain (flag in localStorage survives the round-trips; self-heals via the 180s inflight expiry). Button shows the ready count and a live 'Hatching all… (N left)'. (Diagnosed the report on the live chain: the user's two eggs ARE hatchable — gene blocks exist, node serves the hashes, well under the 18000-block STALE limit — so the block was purely the one-at-a-time UX / stale client view.)
